identity.name: Salamander Contract
identity.summary: A red scroll clasped by a tiny bronze lizard.
identity.description: Costs 3 mana per activation. Deals 10 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 3 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
identity.lore: The signature remains warm even in rain.

effects.description: Costs 3 mana per activation. Deals 10 magical damage per affordable activation. Applies 3 burn through the existing combat keyword rules per affordable activation.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Its fire trace participates in the Elementalist's existing reaction system; arrange it with spells of another element. No extra reaction beyond the shared rules is added.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Kiln Prayer, Lantern Moth into Salamander Contract.
